items.title: Posterior credibility and frequentist coverage
items.statement: Let $(\Theta,\mathcal T)$ be a measurable parameter space and, for each integer $n\ge1$, let $\mathcal E_n=((\mathsf Y_n,\mathcal Y_n),(P_{\theta,n})_{\theta\in\Theta})$ be a statistical experiment. Let $\Pi_{0,n}$ be a proper prior on $(\Theta,\mathcal T)$ and let $y\mapsto\Pi_n(\cdot\mid y)$ be a supplied posterior probability kernel under the associated prior-predictive law. For $0<\gamma<1$, a data-indexed set rule $C_n:\mathsf Y_n\to\mathcal P(\Theta)$ is a posterior credible set at level $1-\gamma$ if its membership graph $\{(y,\theta):\theta\in C_n(y)\}$ is in $\mathcal Y_n\otimes\mathcal T$ and $\Pi_n(C_n(y)\mid y)\ge1-\gamma$ for every $y$ in its declared data domain. At a fixed truth $\theta\in\Theta$, its frequentist coverage is $c_n(\theta):=P_{\theta,n}\{y:\theta\in C_n(y)\}$. For a truth class $\mathcal T_n\subseteq\Theta$, the rule is asymptotically honest at level $1-\gamma$ on $\mathcal T_n$ if $\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\theta\in\mathcal T_n}c_n(\theta)\ge1-\gamma$, and it is asymptotically exactly calibrated there if $\sup_{\theta\in\mathcal T_n}|c_n(\theta)-(1-\gamma)|\to0$.

references.title: Botond Szabó, A. W. van der Vaart, and J. H. van Zanten, Frequentist coverage of adaptive nonparametric Bayesian credible sets, Annals of Statistics 43(4) (2015)
references.locator: §1, distinction between posterior credible mass and repeated-sampling coverage; §§2–3, inverse Gaussian sequence setup and frequentist coverage formulation.

references.title: Evarist Giné and Richard Nickl, Mathematical Foundations of Infinite-Dimensional Statistical Models, Cambridge University Press (2016)
references.locator: §6.4, confidence sets; §8.3, adaptive honest confidence sets and self-similarity restrictions.

references.title: Kolyan Ray, Adaptive Bernstein–von Mises theorems in Gaussian white noise
references.locator: §1, posterior credible sets and their frequentist interpretation; §4.1, adaptive full-parameter confidence sets in direct Gaussian white noise.

items.axiom_use: A proper posterior kernel and the sampling laws are supplied; this definition introduces no existence or choice principle.
items.strategy: Define posterior credibility and fixed-truth coverage separately; state uniform honesty and exact calibration.

items.title: Exact adaptive credible coverage by posterior-null deletion
items.statement:
Assume AC and Countable Choice. Fix $p>0$, $C\ge1$, $0<\beta_-<\beta_+<A<\infty$, $R\ge1$, $L_0\ge1$, an integer $N_0\ge1$, $\rho\ge2$, $m\in(0,R]$, and $0<\gamma<1$. Let a known positive singular-value sequence satisfy $C^{-2}i^{-2p}\le\kappa_i^2\le C^2i^{-2p}$, and observe $X_i=\kappa_i\theta_i+n^{-1/2}\xi_i$ for $i\ge1$, where the fixed truth $\theta=(\theta_i)\in\ell^2(\mathbb N,\mathbb R)$ and the $\xi_i$ are independent $N(0,1)$ variables. For $\alpha>0$, use the product prior $\Pi_\alpha=\bigotimes_{i\ge1}N(0,i^{-1-2\alpha})$ and its product Gaussian posterior with coordinate mean $n\kappa_iX_i/(i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2)$ and variance $(i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2)^{-1}$. Select $\widehat\alpha_n$ as a Borel global maximizer over $[0,A]$ of the marginal log-likelihood score
$$\ell_n(\alpha;X)=-\frac12\sum_{i\ge1}\left[\log\left(1+\frac{n\kappa_i^2}{i^{1+2\alpha}}\right)-\frac{n^2\kappa_i^2X_i^2}{i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2}\right],$$
assuming the score series is finite on a Borel data domain of probability one for the truths below and is upper semicontinuous in $\alpha$ there. The $\widehat\alpha_n=0$ branch uses the whole space $\ell^2$ and asserts no posterior probability on $\ell^2$.

For $\theta\in\ell^2$, write $\|\theta\|_2=(\sum_{i\ge1}\theta_i^2)^{1/2}$. For $B\subseteq\ell^2$, define $\operatorname{diam}_{\ell^2}(B)=\sup_{u,v\in B}\|u-v\|_2$, with $\operatorname{diam}_{\ell^2}(\varnothing)=0$.

For $\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]$, let $\Theta_\beta(R)=\{\theta\in\ell^2:\sum_{i\ge1}i^{2\beta}\theta_i^2\le R^2\}$ and let $\Theta_{\mathrm{pt}}(L_0,N_0,\rho)$ consist of those $\theta\in\ell^2$ satisfying $\sum_{i=N}^{\infty}\theta_i^2\le L_0\sum_{i=N}^{\lfloor\rho N\rfloor}\theta_i^2$ for every integer $N\ge N_0$. Put $\mathcal G_\beta=\Theta_\beta(R)\cap\Theta_{\mathrm{pt}}(L_0,N_0,\rho)\cap\{\theta:\theta_1=0,\ \|\theta\|_2\ge m\}$ and assume the fixed constants make each $\mathcal G_\beta$ nonempty. There exists a single graph-measurable data-indexed set rule $C_{n,\gamma}(X)\subseteq\ell^2$, depending only on the known model and class constants and not on $\theta$ or $\beta$, such that on $\widehat\alpha_n>0$ it has posterior mass $\Pi_{\widehat\alpha_n}(C_{n,\gamma}(X)\mid X)\ge1-\gamma$, its uniform frequentist coverage satisfies
$$\sup_{\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]}\sup_{\theta\in\mathcal G_\beta}\left|P_\theta^{(n)}\{\theta\in C_{n,\gamma}(X)\}-(1-\gamma)\right|\longrightarrow0,$$
and its $\ell^2$-diameter has the no-log rate $n^{-\beta/(1+2\beta+2p)}$ uniformly in the following sense: for every $\eta>0$ there is $K_\eta<\infty$ such that
$$\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{\beta\in[\beta_-,\beta_+]}\sup_{\theta\in\mathcal G_\beta}P_\theta^{(n)}\left\{\operatorname{diam}_{\ell^2}(C_{n,\gamma}(X))>K_\eta n^{-\beta/(1+2\beta+2p)}\right\}\le\eta.$$

references.title: Szabó, van der Vaart and van Zanten, Frequentist coverage of adaptive nonparametric Bayesian credible sets (2015)
references.locator: Theorem 3.6 and §5 supply conservative inflated-ball coverage; model §§2–3. The posterior-null deletion construction and compact-beta uniform diameter argument here are local deductions from the stated local suppliers, not attributed to this article.

items.axiom_use: AC supplies the countable Gaussian product probability model and its inherited Countable Choice. All choices of constants, finite sums, countable sums and set operations below use no stronger choice principle.
items.strategy: Formulate the exact-coverage and no-log-diameter question at the stated inverse-sequence and polished-tail scope.

title: Credible sets and frequentist coverage — Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: A proper Gaussian prior yields a credible interval with undercoverage
items.statement: Assume AC. Observe $Y=\theta+Z$ with fixed truth $\theta\in\mathbb R$, $Z\sim N(0,1)$, and proper prior $\theta\sim N(0,1)$. Let $\phi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ and $\Phi(y)=\int_{-\infty}^y\phi(x)\,dx$, let $z>0$ be the unique number satisfying $\Phi(z)=0.975$, and put $r=z/\sqrt2$. The posterior is $N(Y/2,1/2)$, so the central interval $I(Y)=[Y/2-r,Y/2+r]$ has posterior mass exactly $0.95$ for every $Y$. At the fixed truth $\theta_*=2r+1$, its frequentist coverage is $P\{1\le Z\le4r+1\}<0.95$.
items.axiom_use: AC is inherited through the standard-normal probability-law supplier; no additional choice principle is used.
items.strategy: Complete the square for a proper normal prior and calculate fixed-truth repeated-sampling coverage.

items.title: Sparse-gap truths defeat uniform coverage over a hyperrectangle
items.statement:
Assume AC. Fix $p\ge0$, $C\ge1$, $\beta>0$, finite $A>\beta$, $0<M\le(1984C^8)^{-1}$, and $0<\gamma<1$. For $n\ge3$, observe $X_i=\kappa_i\theta_i+n^{-1/2}Z_i$ in the Gaussian sequence experiment, where $\theta\in\ell^2(\mathbb N_+,\mathbb R)$ is fixed, $C^{-2}i^{-2p}\le\kappa_i^2\le C^2i^{-2p}$, and the $Z_i$ are independent $N(0,1)$. Define $\Theta_\beta(M)=\{\theta\in\ell^2:\sup_{i\ge1}i^{1+2\beta}\theta_i^2\le M\}$. For $0<\alpha\le A$, use the product prior $\Pi_\alpha=\bigotimes_{i\ge1}N(0,i^{-1-2\alpha})$ and its product Gaussian posterior with coordinate mean $\widehat\theta_{n,\alpha,i}(x)=n\kappa_ix_i/(i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2)$ and variance $(i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2)^{-1}$. Select $\widehat\alpha_n$ as a Borel global maximizer over $[0,A]$ of
$$\ell_n(\alpha;x)=-\frac12\sum_{i\ge1}\left[\log\left(1+\frac{n\kappa_i^2}{i^{1+2\alpha}}\right)-\frac{n^2\kappa_i^2x_i^2}{i^{1+2\alpha}+n\kappa_i^2}\right],$$
Assume the score series is finite on a Borel full-measure data domain for the truths considered and is upper semicontinuous in $\alpha$ there. For $\widehat\alpha_n>0$, let $r_{n,\gamma}(\widehat\alpha_n)$ be the $1-\gamma$ posterior quantile of $\|\theta-\widehat\theta_{n,\widehat\alpha_n}(X)\|_2$, and let $\widehat C_n(L)$ be the ball centered at $\widehat\theta_{n,\widehat\alpha_n}(X)$ with radius $Lr_{n,\gamma}(\widehat\alpha_n)$. Set $\widehat C_n(L)=\ell^2$ if $\widehat\alpha_n=0$. There exists a finite fixed $L\ge1$ for which
$$\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{\theta\in\Theta_\beta(M)}P_\theta^{(n)}\{\theta\in\widehat C_n(L)\}\ge1-\gamma$$

references.title: Botond Szabó, A. W. van der Vaart, and J. H. van Zanten, Frequentist coverage of adaptive nonparametric Bayesian credible sets, Annals of Statistics 43(4) (2015)
references.locator: Theorem 3.1 and complete proof in §9; Theorem 3.6 and complete proof in §5 (arXiv:1310.4489v5).

items.axiom_use: The model inherits AC through the Gaussian product prior; no stronger choice principle is asserted.
items.strategy: Apply the exact sparse-gap subsequence bound and show its truth lies outside every fixed polished-tail class.
